tagline.en: Tencent Hunyuan's feed-forward 3D reconstruction model — turn images or video into point clouds, Gaussian splats, depth and normals.
tagline.zh: 腾讯混元的前馈式 3D 重建模型——把图像或视频转成点云、高斯 splat、深度图与法线图。

en: HunyuanWorld-Mirror, from Tencent Hunyuan (HY-World), is a 3D reconstruction model. It takes images or video of a scene and reconstructs its geometry in a single feed-forward pass, without a lengthy per-scene optimization.

The model outputs a rich set of geometry products from the same input: a point-cloud PLY, a Gaussian-splat PLY, depth maps, and normal maps. Its modalities span image-to-3D and video-to-3D reconstruction, released as code and weights.
In WorldFoundry it runs through the HunyuanWorld-Mirror pipeline as a 3D task — hand it one or more images (or a path to them), and it writes the reconstruction artifacts to the output directory.
zh: HunyuanWorld-Mirror 由腾讯混元(HY-World)开发,是一个 3D 重建模型。它接收场景的图像或视频,以单次前馈方式重建其几何,而无需耗时的逐场景优化。
该模型可从同一输入产出一整套几何结果:点云 PLY、高斯 splat PLY、深度图与法线图。其模态涵盖图像到 3D 与视频到 3D 的重建,以代码加权重形式发布。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过 HunyuanWorld-Mirror pipeline 以 3D 任务运行——给它一张或多张图片(或它们的路径),它便把重建结果写入输出目录。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want fast, feed-forward 3D reconstruction from images or video, producing point clouds, Gaussian splats, and depth/normal maps in one pass.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从图像或视频进行快速的前馈式 3D 重建、一次性产出点云、高斯 splat 与深度/法线图时,使用它。

notFor.en: It is a reconstruction model, not a text- or image-to-video generator. Running it needs the checkpoint, a compatible GPU, and 3D dependencies such as gsplat and open3d.
notFor.zh: 它是重建模型,不是文/图生视频的生成器。运行它需要 checkpoint、兼容的 GPU,以及 gsplat、open3d 等 3D 依赖。

en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction from images or video
Outputs point-cloud and Gaussian-splat PLY, plus depth and normal maps
zh: 从图像或视频进行前馈式 3D 重建
输出点云与高斯 splat PLY,以及深度图和法线图
同时支持图像到 3D 与视频到 3D
以代码加权重形式发布
